text:
Incident Bot: :rotating_light: Paging @Alex (oncall). Hosted API backend is showing sustained request queue growth on the GPU serving tier starting 1753327800. p95 latency jumped from ~120ms -> 900ms, p99 ~2.8s. Error surge: 504 timeouts and 429s for some customers. Autoscaler logs show repeated scale failures (scale up throttled). Full details in runbook: https://internal/runbooks/hosted-queue-autoscale :rotating_light:

Alex (oncall): On it. Acknowledge. grabbing context and logs now. Do we have a customer-facing outage?

Incident Bot: Impact: increased tail latency and intermittent 504s for the hosted text-generation endpoint /v1/generate. Traffic spike originated at 1753327600 from an external partner job (high concurrency). 27% of requests currently queued > 2s. Top error codes: 504, 429. Top models affected: redwood/open-8b and redwood/opt-6.7b serving on gpu-pool-east.

Alex (oncall): Ok. First actions: 1) try manual scale to add GPUs to gpu-pool-east, 2) enable fallback routing to gpu-pool-west, 3) put a soft rate limit on new signups and partner token. Jamal, can you take manual autoscaler ops?

Jamal S: Jumping in. I see HPA/autoscaler logs: `scale request rejected: cluster quota limit reached for region-east`. Cloud console shows no spare nodes in the region — hitting instance quota. Attempting emergency burst request to cloud provider now. ETA ~3-5m.

Amanda H: Noted customer reports in #support: two enterprise customers reported generation timeouts and one product team flagged dropdowns failing. I'll post customer impact update once we confirm mitigation.

Alex (oncall): While Jamal attempts burst, let's reduce pressure: enable short-circuit fallback to smaller model variants and enable prefix caching for repeated prompts. Ryan, can you flip traffic to lower-cost models for non-critical routes?

Ryan C: I can push a routing rule for non-SLA customers to model-quant-4bit-8b variant with lower mem footprint. Pushing now:
```json
POST /internal-routing/rules
{ "match": { "customer_tier": "free|trial" }, "route_to": "quant-8b-west" }
```
Applying -> success. That should cut 18% of load to east pool.

Jamal S: Cloud burst request accepted but slower than usual. Provisioning 2 additional GPU nodes (A100) in region-east. New nodes expected in ~6m. Autoscaler still failing to go beyond current max due to a mis-configured hard limit: `max_replicas: 40` set in deployment override. I'm editing to raise to 80.

Alex (oncall): Good catch. Jamal, after you update max_replicas, trigger `kubectl patch` to bump deployment minReplicas as a temporary override. Use: `kubectl -n infra autoscaler patch ...`

Jamal S: Doing it now. Patch applied. Also manually created a provisional nodepool and attached to the autoscaling group. Watch logs for scaling activity.

Incident Bot: System note: batcher queue length peaked at 14k; continuous batching caused head-of-line delays. Recommendation: disable continuous batching for the affected routes to favor low-latency immediate dispatch.

Alex (oncall): Agreed. Amanda-- please prepare a quick customer message: "We're investigating elevated latency and timeouts; mitigations in progress." Keep it short.

Amanda H: Draft posted in #incidents-customer-updates. Waiting on confirmation of recovery to post publicly.

Ryan C: I disabled continuous batching for the /v1/generate route with a feature flag `batcher.low_latency=true`. This will increase per-token cost but should reduce queue hold delays for p95. Flag flip done.

Jamal S: Kubernetes events show new pods coming up. Autoscaler is now able to scale after bumping max_replicas and attaching nodepool. New replica count rising from 28 -> 52. Traffic draining.

Alex (oncall): Monitoring p95/p99. Any change in errors?

Incident Bot: Metrics: 1753327920 - p95: 310ms (down from 900ms), p99: 1.6s (down from 2.8s). Queue length: 1400 (down from 14k). 504s reduced by 85%, 429s still present but lower.

Amanda H: Posting interim update to customers: "We've applied scaling and routing mitigations; latency improving. We will follow up with a root cause and timeline." :thumbsup:

Alex (oncall): Good. Still seeing some p99 tail. We'll keep priority on finishing capacity increase and validating KV/prefix caches. Jamal, any stuck requests or backlog draining slowly?

Jamal S: Backlog draining. One thing: the KV cache hit rate dropped after node churn — some pods warmed slowly and missed cached KV prefixes. I'm warming caches via a controlled replay: `scripts/warm-prefix-cache --targets=podset-east --concurrency=20`. Running now.

Ryan C: Observing memory pressure on a few new nodes. I'm throttling lower-priority background jobs to free up GPU memory for inference.

Incident Bot: Note: we recorded several customer tokens that issued high QPS from the partner job. Recommend post-incident: implement per-token circuit breaker and add token-based soft quota with early 429s.

Alex (oncall): Agreed — add to action items. For now, can we throttle the offending partner token? Jamal, can you block or reduce token throughput temporarily?

Jamal S: Throttled partner token via rate-limiter -> cut to 10rps. Their background job had been ramping to 800rps. We'll notify them.

Amanda H: I'll draft a note to the partner and affected customers. Also creating a customer incident ticket for enterprise accounts who saw 504s.

Alex (oncall): Handing off to Jamal for continued mitigation and to drive capacity increase. I'll remain available for escalation and will start the incident timeline. Jamal, summarize current state in 10m and then hand to oncall-next.

Jamal S: Summary: autoscaler hard limit fixed, nodepool provision in progress, replicas 52, queue length decreasing, batcher low-latency flag enabled, partner token throttled, cache warm in progress. Remaining risk: p99 tail for a subset of long-context requests, KV cache warming, and downstream customers who saw 504s. Next steps: validate stability for 15m, adjust autoscaler policies, and coordinate quota increases with cloud infra.

Alex (oncall): Great. Oncall-next is @Ryan C. Ryan, you'll take the handoff at 1753327965. I'll include all logs and the runbook link in the incident page.

Ryan C: Ack takeover at 1753327965. I'll monitor for 30m and start a postmortem draft. Initial root cause hypothesis: sudden external traffic spike + region quota hard cap + batching head-of-line blocking.

Incident Bot: Incident status: mitigated -> partial (service restored for most customers, tail latency improving). Severity: P2 -> investigating for RCA and long-term mitigations.

Alex (oncall): Closing active paging loop. Thanks team. Action items for postmortem: 1) per-token circuit breakers, 2) autoscaler hard limit audit, 3) regional spare capacity playbook, 4) batching policy defaults per route, 5) cache warm/repop strategy. Assign owners in postmortem doc.

Amanda H: I'll coordinate customer comms and postmortem stakeholders.

Jamal S: I'll follow up with cloud provider for quota increase and keep this incident thread updated.

Ryan C: Will draft timeline and attach metrics graphs.

Alex (oncall): Good job. Marking thread for incident log export.

Incident Bot: Exported incident transcript to: https://incidents/reports/1753327890.
